name: Henry
label: middle-aged man · 50s · measured British
description: A British man in his fifties with a rich, warm, measured voice. Thoughtful and articulate, like a respected radio presenter reading history. Unhurried, precise diction.
ref_text: The old house at the end of the lane had stood empty for many years. Each autumn, the leaves gathered on its steps, and the village children wondered who had lived there, and why they had never come back.
